clarifications.I14: G1 establishes serialization/replay prerequisites only; G7 qualifies actual crash durability.
clarifications.I15: G1 checks local storage/edit traversal and serialization counters; G8 measures scaling and latency. An independent counter must fail an intentional whole-document-flattening mutant. Explicit Save/checkpoint serialization is outside normal-local-edit work and must be separately measured, never hidden in its budget.
clarifications.I17: G4 rejects stale geometry/render results keyed to an old semantic revision; G6 requires editable accessibility reads/actions/offscreen navigation on that same revision. Delay each pipeline independently during an edit, then require either coherent read-back or explicit stale rejection. Matching emitted revision numbers alone do not qualify actual AT behavior. This maps to V6-5/N0.
